scenario.text: Alex and Mira sit inside the Blue Heron Inn in the town of Brackenport. Rain taps the inn’s leaded windows while a fire warms the common room. Alex stays at the table as Mira places two healing potions beside him and describes their quest.

### OUTPUT FORMAT
Return one JSON object with optional "places" and "current" fields.
Set "current" to the final place’s exact name or known alias.
Use "current":"" after an explicit departure to an unknown destination.
Omit "current" when the player’s location remains unchanged or cannot be established.
Put newly established places and changed details in "places", an array of objects.
Shape: {"places":[{"name":"<place>"}],"current":"<final place>"}.
Each entry has "name" and may include "description", "aliases", and "parent".
Reuse known names or aliases for existing places.
Set "parent" to the containing place’s name when containment is established. Include that containing place in "places" when new.
Use "parent":"" only when established facts remove a containing place.
Write descriptions from established facts. Preserve known facts when replacing a description.
Include established alternative names in "aliases". Preserve existing aliases when replacing them.
Omit unchanged details. Return {} when there is nothing to update.
